title: Cherit/Quotes
summary:
"Wish that I could [come out], but everyone would get mad. I'm not supposed to be about during the daylight."
- Cherit, to Lok Lambert (A Seeker Is Born)

"It worked! He's a natural, like I said."
- Cherit to Dante Vale , after Dante gives Lok Lambert a Freelancer amulet (The Casterwill Client )

"Seekers learn most powers by poring over ancient tomes, but a simple one like Boltflare can be picked up by the aid of a fine teacher."
- Cherit to Lok Lambert (The Casterwill Client)

"Need a wingman, Lok?"
- Cherit to Lok Lambert whilst rushing down a cliff face (The Titan in the Temple of Sun)
